# VirtualContainerEventOptions Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains optional parameters for registering a virtual container event.

## Properties

### **containers**
`containers?: VirtualContainer[];`

If this value is set, this event will only fire for the virtual containers within this collection.

Type: [*VirtualContainer*](VirtualContainer.md)[]
